tool_schemas.name: plan_task
tool_schemas.description: Create a new planning “thought” session for a project and either attach it to an existing task (when task_id is provided) or create a new task from name/description when create_task is true, returning the created thought session and the task it is associated with. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, IDs do not match the expected patterns, or task_id is omitted without create_task plus name/description; raises NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist or the referenced task does not exist in the project. Raises FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to access the project, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the project’s thought/task operation limits are exceeded.

project_id.description: Project id to create/attach the planning thought session to.

task_id.description: Existing task id to plan (if omitted, a new task may be created from name/description).

name.description: Task name to create when task_id is not provided.

description.description: Task description to create when task_id is not provided.

notes.description: Optional notes/context to include in planning.

priority.description: Optional priority to set on the task (higher means more important).

related_files.description: Optional list of related file paths/URIs for planning context.

create_task.description: Whether to create a new task when task_id is not provided.

tool_schemas.name: analyze_task
tool_schemas.description: Append an “analyze” operation to a thought session for the specified task (creating a new session when session_id is omitted) and return the updated/created session entry plus any task fields updated by the analysis. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if IDs are malformed, required fields are missing, or session_id (when provided) is not a thought-session ID; raises NOT_FOUND if the project, task, or session (when provided) does not exist or the session does not belong to the project/task. Raises FORBIDDEN for unauthorized project access and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when analysis/thought operations exceed allowed limits.

project_id.description: Project id the task belongs to.

session_id.description: Existing thought session id to append analysis to (optional).

include_codebase_check.description: Whether to explicitly include systematic codebase inspection in the analysis.

related_files.description: Optional list of related file paths/URIs to focus the analysis.

tool_schemas.name: reflect_task
tool_schemas.description: Append a “reflect” operation to a thought session for the specified task (creating a new session when session_id is omitted) and return the updated/created session entry. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing or IDs are malformed; raises NOT_FOUND if the project, task, or referenced session does not exist or does not belong to the same project/task. Raises FORBIDDEN for unauthorized access and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if reflection/thought operations exceed limits.

project_id.description: Project id the task belongs to.

session_id.description: Existing thought session id to append reflection to (optional).

focus.description: Optional reflection focus (e.g., risks, completeness, optimizations, best practices).

tool_schemas.name: split_tasks
tool_schemas.description: Generate a subtask plan from root_task_id and apply it to the project according to updateMode (append adds new tasks, selective matches by name to update or add, overwrite removes unfinished tasks before applying, and clearAllTasks clears tasks), returning the resulting set of created/updated tasks and any dependency links created when create_dependencies is true. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs, missing required fields, invalid backup_reason for a mode that performs clearing, or max_tasks outside supported bounds; raises NOT_FOUND if the project or root task does not exist. Raises CONFLICT if updateMode requests clearing/overwriting but a backup cannot be created or the root task is not eligible for splitting under the requested mode, FORBIDDEN if not authorized, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if task creation/update limits are exceeded.

project_id.description: Project id whose task plan will be decomposed/updated.

root_task_id.description: Root task id to split into subtasks.

updateMode.description: How to apply generated subtasks to existing tasks.

max_tasks.description: Optional cap on the number of subtasks to generate.

create_dependencies.description: Whether to create dependency links between generated tasks.

backup_reason.description: Backup reason to use when updateMode triggers backup/clearing.

tool_schemas.name: list_tasks
tool_schemas.description: List tasks for a project with optional filtering by status and inclusion of deleted records and dependency data, returning a paged result set ordered by sort/order with up to limit items and an opaque next_cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if parameters are invalid (e.g., limit out of range or unsupported enum values). Raises NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to read the project.

project_id.description: Project id whose tasks to list.

include_deleted.description: Whether to include soft-deleted tasks (deleted_at not null).

include_dependencies.description: Whether to include dependency data for each task.

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: execute_task
tool_schemas.description: Append an “execute” operation to a thought session for the specified task (creating a new session when session_id is omitted) and, when update_status is true, transition the task to in_progress as part of execution, returning the updated/created session entry and any task status changes. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing or IDs are malformed; raises NOT_FOUND if the project, task, or referenced session does not exist or does not belong to the same project/task. Raises CONFLICT if update_status is requested but the task is in a terminal state (completed/cancelled) or otherwise cannot transition to in_progress, plus FORBIDDEN and QUOTA_EXCEEDED under the same conditions as other thought operations.

project_id.description: Project id the task belongs to.

session_id.description: Existing thought session id to append execution to (optional).

update_status.description: Whether to update the task status to in_progress during execution.

tool_schemas.name: verify_task
tool_schemas.description: Append a “verify” operation to a thought session for the specified task (creating a new session when session_id is omitted), applying verification_criteria when provided, and return the updated/created session entry. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if IDs are malformed or required fields are missing; raises NOT_FOUND if the project, task, or referenced session does not exist or does not belong to the same project/task. Raises FORBIDDEN for unauthorized access and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when verification/thought operations exceed limits.

project_id.description: Project id the task belongs to.

session_id.description: Existing thought session id to append verification to (optional).

verification_criteria.description: Optional explicit verification criteria to apply (overrides/augments task field).

related_files.description: Optional list of related file paths/URIs to check during verification.

tool_schemas.name: complete_task
tool_schemas.description: Mark a task as completed, store the provided structured completion_report (and optional summary/notes/completed_at), and optionally update dependent tasks’ dependency status when update_dependents is true, returning the updated task record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if completion_report is missing/invalid, IDs are malformed, or completed_at is not a valid date-time; raises NOT_FOUND if the project or task does not exist. Raises CONFLICT if the task is already completed/cancelled or cannot transition to completed from its current state, FORBIDDEN if unauthorized, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if completion/update operations exceed limits.

project_id.description: Project id the task belongs to.

task_id.description: Task id to mark as completed.

completion_report.description: Structured completion report to store on the task.

summary.description: Optional short completion summary to store on the task.

notes.description: Optional completion notes to store on the task.

completed_at.description: Completion timestamp (defaults to now if omitted).

update_dependents.description: Whether to update dependency status of related tasks after completion.

tool_schemas.name: delete_task
tool_schemas.description: Soft-delete a task by setting its deleted marker and return the updated task record, but only for tasks that are not completed to preserve the audit trail. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if IDs are malformed or required fields are missing; raises NOT_FOUND if the project or task does not exist. Raises CONFLICT if the task is completed (or otherwise non-deletable under current state/dependency constraints), FORBIDDEN if unauthorized, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if deletion operations exceed limits.

project_id.description: ID of the project that owns the task.

task_id.description: ID of the task to delete (must not be completed).

tool_schemas.name: clear_all_tasks
tool_schemas.description: Clear unfinished tasks and reset the task list

project_id.description: ID of the project whose unfinished tasks will be cleared.

reason.description: Backup reason recorded for the snapshot created before clearing.

tool_schemas.name: update_task
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing task in the given project, including core fields (name/description/notes/priority/status), dependency links (set/add/remove), and planning fields (implementation_guide/verification_criteria), and returns the updated task record. If the task is already completed, this endpoint rejects attempts to modify any fields other than summary and related_files, and it rejects invalid or disallowed status transitions (including attempting to “un-complete” a completed task). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs, invalid enums, out-of-range values, or invalid dependency_updates payloads; NOT_FOUND if the project or task does not exist (or the task is deleted and updates are not permitted); CONFLICT if dependency changes reference non-existent tasks, cross-project tasks, self-dependencies, or would create an invalid dependency state; and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized for the project.

project_id.description: ID of the project that owns the task.

task_id.description: ID of the task to update.

priority.description: Updated task priority (higher usually means more important).

status.description: Updated lifecycle status for the task.

implementation_guide.description: Updated implementation guide (may be restricted for completed tasks).

verification_criteria.description: Updated verification criteria (may be restricted for completed tasks).

related_files.description: Updated list of related file paths/URLs for the task.

set.description: Replace all dependencies with this list.

depends_on_task_id.description: Task ID that this task depends on.

add.description: Add these dependencies (without removing existing ones).

depends_on_task_id.description: Task ID that this task depends on.

remove.description: Remove dependencies pointing to these task IDs.

completion_report.description: Updated completion report object (typically set when completing a task).

completed_at.description: Completion timestamp (typically set when completing a task).

tool_schemas.name: query_task
tool_schemas.description: Searches tasks within a project by keyword (matched against task text fields) or by exact task ID, returning an abbreviated task list sorted as requested; results are paged with limit and an opaque cursor, where the response includes the next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed project_id, invalid status values, limit outside 1–200, or invalid sort fields/order. Raises NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to read the project; include_deleted controls whether soft-deleted tasks are eligible to appear in results.

project_id.description: ID of the project whose tasks will be searched.

query.description: Keyword to search in task fields (e.g., name/description/notes) or an exact task ID.

status.description: Filter results by one or more task statuses.

include_deleted.description: Whether to include soft-deleted tasks in results.

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_task_detail
tool_schemas.description: Fetches the full task record for the given task_id in a project, optionally including dependency records, and returns the complete unabridged fields (including implementation_guide and verification_criteria). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs or invalid flags. Raises NOT_FOUND if the project or task does not exist, or if the task is soft-deleted and include_deleted is false; raises FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to read the project.

project_id.description: ID of the project that owns the task.

task_id.description: ID of the task to fetch in full detail.

include_dependencies.description: Whether to include dependency records for the task.

include_deleted.description: Whether to allow fetching a soft-deleted task.

tool_schemas.name: process_thought
tool_schemas.description: Appends a new auditable “thought” operation to a thought session for the given root task (creating a new session when thought_session_id is omitted) and returns the updated thought session/output for this step, including whether next_thought_needed remains true. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs, missing required fields, or an invalid thought_session_id format; raises NOT_FOUND if the project or root task does not exist, or if a provided thought_session_id does not exist in the project. Raises CONFLICT if the provided thought_session_id belongs to a different project or is not associated with the given root_task_id, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized for the project.

project_id.description: ID of the project the thought process belongs to.

root_task_id.description: Root task ID this thought process is centered on.

thought_session_id.description: Existing thought session ID to append to; if omitted a new session may be created.

content.description: The thought content/instructions to process and evolve.

next_thought_needed.description: Set to false when no further thinking steps are needed.

mode.description: Thought session mode (fixed for this endpoint).

tool_schemas.name: init_project_rules
tool_schemas.description: Creates or replaces the project’s stored rules/spec with the provided rules_spec (optionally recording an explicit rules_version and summary) and returns the updated rules/spec metadata for the project. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed project_id, missing rules_spec, or an invalid rules_version type. Raises NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist, CONFLICT if rules_version is provided and is not a valid next version for the current project rules state, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to administer the project.

project_id.description: ID of the project whose rules/spec will be initialized or updated.

rules_spec.description: Full rules/spec object to store for the project.

rules_version.description: Optional explicit version number for the rules/spec.

summary.description: Optional summary describing what was initialized/changed.

tool_schemas.name: list_projects
tool_schemas.description: List projects visible to the caller, optionally filtered by status and repository_url. Returns a paginated list ordered by updated_at descending. Raises FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks access and VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid pagination parameters.

repository_url.description: Optional exact repository URL to filter projects.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_project
tool_schemas.description: Fetch a single project by id. Returns the full projects row. Raises NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist or is not accessible to the caller.

tool_schemas.name: update_project
tool_schemas.description: Update mutable project fields and/or transition project status between active and archived. Returns the updated project. Refuses invalid status transitions and raises NOT_FOUND if the project is missing.

tool_schemas.name: create_task
tool_schemas.description: Create a new task within a project in status planned (default) or ready, enforcing per-project task limits and unique active task names. Returns the created task row. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed fields and CONFLICT when an active task with the same name already exists.

project_id.description: Project id to create the task in.

name.description: Task name (must be unique among non-deleted tasks within the project).

metadata.name: Chain of Thought
